body.name: Local exact-support column fibers
body.construction: For each \(j\in V\), set \(M_j(C)=C_{:,\operatorname{ch}_G(j)}\), \(u_j(C)=p_j-C_{:,j}\), \(\mathcal A_j(C)=\{e_j+\sum_{k\in\operatorname{ch}_G(j)}w_ke_k:M_j(C)w=u_j(C)\}\), \(\mathcal A_j^{\times}(C)=\{q\in\mathcal A_j(C):w_k\ne0\; \forall k\in\operatorname{ch}_G(j)\}\), and \(W_j(C)=\operatorname{span}(\mathcal A_j(C))\).
